hoaxes.title: General Reasoning's Avalon-M1 agents will play a televised tournament against human teams
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Avalon-M1 is a research release where teams of up to nine AI agents play episodes lasting up to 12 hours.

hoaxes.title: Netflix will release the new Cliff Booth film one minute per day until December 23
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Tarantino showed its first 17 minutes at AFI Fest; it opens in IMAX on Nov 25 and on Netflix on Dec 23.

hoaxes.title: Modern Warfare 4 adds a mode where every weapon fires foam darts
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Modern Warfare 4 fully launched on October 23, with early Steam reviews about 90% positive.

hoaxes.title: Pollen's Microduck robot gets a 'rubber duck' mode that quacks when it spots a coding bug
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The $399 Microduck walking robot has passed 20,000 preorders, with delivery targeted before Christmas.
